name: Jerk chicken stuffed plantain balls
creator: @softlivingmethods
note: The reel shows no amounts, so these are estimates built from what it shows.
ingredients: 1 tbsp flour or cornstarch, if the mash is sticky
Mango habanero or yellow pepper sauce to drizzle
steps: Marinate the chicken in the jerk sauce for at least 1 hr.
Grill 5 to 6 min per side to 165°F, basting as it cooks, then chop it small.
Boil the peeled plantains 10 to 15 min until soft, mash with salt, and let cool.
Flatten about 1/3 cup of mash in your palm, add chicken and cheese, and seal it into a ball. Chill 15 min.
Fry at 350°F for 3 to 4 min until deep golden, then drain on a rack.
Pull apart and drizzle with the sauce.

name: Pastel al horno de yuca y pollo en salsa criolla
creator: @chefejpr
note: Amounts are from the caption. Bake time and temperature are estimates, since the video doesn't give them.
ingredients: Masa: 5 lb yuca, 8 green bananas, 1/2 cup achiote oil plus extra, 1 tsp chicken bouillon, 3 tsp salt

Chicken: 4 large chicken breasts, 1/2 white onion, 11.5 oz roasted pimientos, 1/4 cup sofrito, 4 tbsp garlic paste, 10 olives, 8 oz tomato sauce, 1 packet sazón, 1 tsp bouillon, 1 tbsp salt, 2 1/2 cups water
Banana leaves, aluminum foil, baking pan
steps: Boil the chicken 30 to 40 min until it shreds by hand, then shred it.
Cook the onion until translucent. Add the pimientos, then the sofrito, garlic paste, olives, and tomato sauce, then the sazón, bouillon, and salt, 30 sec each.
Stir in the chicken, add the water, cover, and cook 15 to 20 min on medium.
Peel the yuca and green bananas, remove the yuca's center string, and grate everything. Mix in the achiote oil, bouillon, and salt.
Line the pan with a banana leaf brushed with achiote oil. Layer half the masa, all the chicken, then the rest of the masa, and brush the top with oil.
Cover with a banana leaf and wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 1/2 hr covered, then 15 to 20 min uncovered (estimate). Rest 20 min, slice, and garnish with pimiento strips.

name: Jerk chicken plantain lasagna
creator: @letkadocook
note: The creator hasn't posted the recipe yet, so this version is built from the finished dish in the reel.
ingredients: 5 to 6 very ripe plantains, sliced lengthwise
1 onion, 1 red and 1 green bell pepper, 3 cloves garlic
1 cup tomato sauce, 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 tsp thyme
3 cups mozzarella and 1 cup white cheddar or Jack
Oil for frying, plus parsley or cilantro
steps: Marinate the chicken at least 1 hr, bake at 400°F for about 25 min, then shred.
Fry the plantain strips 2 to 3 min per side until golden.
Sauté the onion, peppers, and garlic, add the chicken, sauce, stock, and thyme, and simmer 10 min until thick.
In a greased 9×13 dish, layer plantains, chicken, and cheese twice, then finish with plantains and cheese.
Bake covered at 375°F for 25 min, then uncovered for 10 to 15 min.
Rest 15 min, then add the herbs.

name: Loaded potato wedges
creator: @cookinginthemidwest
ingredients: Heath Riles Garlic Butter seasoning, or any seasoning
steps: Cut the potatoes into even wedges and boil with the baking soda (add it slowly) for 6 to 8 min until just fork tender.
Drain, then toss with the oil and seasoning.
Air fry at 400°F for 20 to 25 min, shaking a few times, until crispy.
Top with the cheese and bacon and air fry 1 to 2 min to melt.
Finish with green onions and serve with ranch.

name: Crispy potato salad
creator: @eatinghealthytoday (via dr.vegan)
note: Ingredients are from the caption. The method is a suggestion, since the caption gives none.
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper, 3 onions, 6 pickles, 1 handful walnuts, 1 bunch parsley, 3 spring onions
Dressing: 1/4 cup olive oil, 1 tsp tomato paste, 1 tsp paprika paste, 1 tsp each of pul biber, salt, black pepper and chili powder, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1 to 2 tbsp pomegranate molasses
steps: Cube the potatoes, toss with oil and salt, and roast at 425°F for 30 to 35 min (or air fry at 400°F for about 20 min).
Chop the salad ingredients and toast the walnuts.
Whisk the dressing until the pastes dissolve.
Toss everything together and fold in the hot potatoes right before serving.

name: Red velvet "guts" cinnamon rolls
creator: @toastdbakery
note: The creator's recipe is gated behind a comment, so these amounts are a standard red velvet roll dough.
ingredients: Dough: 1 cup warm milk, 2 1/4 tsp instant yeast, 1/4 cup sugar, 1 egg, 4 tbsp melted butter, 3 1/2 cups flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla, red gel coloring plus a dot of blue
Filling: 1/2 cup soft butter, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1 1/2 tbsp cinnamon
Icing: 4 oz cream cheese, 2 tbsp butter, 2 cups powdered sugar, 3 to 5 tbsp milk, red gel plus a speck of blue
steps: Make the dough, knead 5 to 7 min, and let it rise about 1 hr until doubled.
Roll it to about 12×18 in and spread the filling over it.
Roll the long edge 2 to 3 turns into a thin tube, cut it off, and repeat.
Snake the tubes tightly in a lined 9×13 pan like intestines, add a few dough balls on top, and rise 30 min.
Bake at 350°F for 22 to 28 min.
Thin the red icing until pourable and flood it over the warm rolls.

name: Ghostface cupcakes
creator: Omnixa Kitchen
note: The video shows only the technique, so the cupcake and buttercream amounts are a basic vanilla recipe.
ingredients: Cupcakes: 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 cup butter, 3/4 cup sugar, 2 eggs, 2 tsp vanilla, 1/2 cup milk
Buttercream: 1 cup butter, 4 cups powdered sugar, 2 to 3 tbsp milk, 1 tsp vanilla, black gel coloring
Dark liners, piping bags with a large round tip, parchment squares, offset spatula, pointed tool, ball tool
steps: Bake the cupcakes at 350°F for 18 to 20 min and cool completely.
Color a third of the buttercream black.
Pipe a black swirl, press it flat under a parchment square, and peel the paper off.
Pipe a thick white blob at the top and drag it down to a point for the mask.
Push the white aside into slanted eyes, nose slits, and a long oval mouth.
Optionally flick thinned red gel on for splatter.

name: Puff pastry sausage ghosts
creator: @diana_ovinnikova
note: Translated from the creator's Ukrainian caption.
steps: Stand the sausage halves cut side down on a lined sheet.
Roll the pastry thin, cut it into squares, and poke out eyes and a mouth with a straw.
Drape a square over each sausage to make a ghost.
Brush with egg, add sesame if you like, and bake at 350°F (180°C) for about 20 min until golden.

name: At-home magic mouthwash
creator: @rphreviews (pharmacist)
note: Anbesol contains benzocaine, which isn't for kids under 2 and can rarely cause a serious blood reaction. Benadryl can cause drowsiness. Check with your doctor.
ingredients: 30 mL generic Mylanta or Maalox (shake first)
steps: Pour all three into a glass and stir well.
Move it to a clean travel bottle and shake. It keeps 14 days in the fridge or at room temperature.
Swish 5 mL, let a little trickle down your throat, and spit.

name: Hot cocoa bark
creator: Restaurant Clicks
note: Making these for Girl Scouts: double it for a troop, bag pieces in cellophane with ribbon, keep cool. Steps 5-7 are estimates (screenshot cut off after step 4).
steps: Line a 9x13 pan with parchment paper.
Melt milk chocolate in 30-second bursts, stirring between each.
Spread evenly in the pan.
Top with marshmallows, pressing in gently.
(estimate) Melt white chocolate the same way and drizzle over the top.
(estimate) Sprinkle with the cocoa mix and crushed candy canes.
(estimate) Chill ~30 min until firm, then break or cut into pieces.

name: Nightmare Before Christmas bark
creator: Kayy
ingredients: Purple and green gel food coloring (oil-based/candy colors work best)
Black & white sprinkles plus orange pumpkin sprinkles
6-8 white chocolate wafers or candy melts (Jack faces)
Black decorating gel or edible marker
steps: Line the pan with parchment, melt the dark chocolate and spread it.
Melt the white chocolate and set about a third aside.
Tint two small spoonfuls of the rest purple and green.
Dot white, purple and green over the dark chocolate and swirl with a toothpick.
Pipe a few curly spiral hills with the reserved plain white.
Press in the white wafers for Jack faces, then add marshmallows, candy canes and sprinkles.
Chill 30-40 min, draw on eyes and stitched grins, and break into pieces so each has a Jack.
